next_data_request.request: One more crawl hop from the 444 nodes at the depth limit
next_data_request.why: 444 nodes are dead ends only because the crawl stopped at hop 4. 56,672,165 KZT arrives at them and its onward path is unrecorded, so they cannot be told apart from the 1,110 nodes where money genuinely appears to stop.
next_data_request.feasibility_note: Same collection method, one hop further. Node count grows with the fan-out already seen at hop 3, so scope the extraction first.

next_data_request.request: Hour-level timestamps in place of calendar dates
next_data_request.why: 327 nodes have at least one day on which money both arrived and left, covering 65,673,806 KZT. At day resolution the order of those movements is unresolved, and dwell time is what separates a node passing funds through from one that happened to transact twice.
next_data_request.feasibility_note: The field almost certainly exists in the source ledger and was reduced on export; a re-export would not need a new crawl.

next_data_request.request: Inbound transfers to the 81 seed accounts, one hop back
next_data_request.why: Seeds moved 55,294,178 KZT out against 14,849,167 KZT observed arriving, leaving 40,445,011 KZT with no recorded payer. This is the only request that can reach above the seeds at all.
next_data_request.feasibility_note: Reverses the crawl direction, so it is a new collection rather than a re-export. The unattributed figure assumes seeds opened the window at zero; the data carries no balances, so read it as the amount without an observed payer, not as proven outside money.

next_data_request.why: 36 accounts show their whole observed life inside one calendar day with money both in and out, covering 3,749,141 KZT. An opening date would separate an account opened for the purpose from a long-standing one used once, which the transfer record on its own cannot.
next_data_request.feasibility_note: A static attribute, cheap to join, but it changes the reading of a small set of nodes rather than the structure. Worth asking for alongside a higher item, not on its own.

next_data_request.why: Rejected on the present evidence. None of the three tables carries an institution, and nothing in gid, depth, date or amount stands in for one, so there is no figure here that would change if it arrived. Asking for it would be an opinion about what helps, not a finding.
next_data_request.feasibility_note: Unevaluable from this dataset. Keep the request on the list, but rank it only once something in the data shows what it would buy.
